name: evomolsteer-affinity-terminal-lineage
description: Separate survival from descendant affinity credit and test intact ancestral coordinate modes without online affinity gradients.
---

Final predicted CK2 affinity remains primary; energy is secondary after a clear
gain. Preserve the global measured affinity parent on regression. Read complete
input and compare mean, unique mean, best and Top5 separately. Steer100 is a
historical subset, not a verified full-data maximum or matched heldout arm.

The existing control can be active despite a small signed mean affinity effect.
Use actual FLOWR finite differences, zero/native equality, injection RMS and
absolute paired changes before diagnosing a weak dose. Flat response supports
dose exploration; worse affinity supports target/feature revision; a positive
gain supports parent refinement. Stronger dose is not automatically better.

This revision uses original recorded lineage only. selected_indices[j, child]
maps a node j+1 slot to its node j parent. Start with identity at the last scored
node, then apply indices[j] backwards. Never apply selection at the final scored
row to that same row's pre-selection labels. Late recorded selection can inform
the future annotation even when its geometry lies outside the learned window.
All mined coordinate features and production guidance stay inside the dynamic
learned coordinate window. Read times, support and source hashes, never hardcode
0.5 or manufacture arbitrary bins.

Survival means having observable descendants at the last recorded score row.
Terminal credit is mean recorded joint-latent head score among those descendants.
Extinction is missing future affinity, not a low score and never zero. The last
recorded score is not the decoded final-molecule affinity rescore: report its
exact time and distinction. Do not claim a causal mechanism from either label.

Early ancestor collapse is strong. Quote node-ancestor medians and missing
coverage numerically. Do not force terminal-credit high/low strata across the
whole window, fill missing observations or weight a teacher by its clone count.
Survival-versus-extinction local moments are descriptions: equal children within
extant parent, then equal batches; residual root dependence remains. BH covers
all400 predeclared survival field/measure tests. These are survival associations,
not tests of terminal affinity features. Overlapping Gaussian regions need not
identify independent causal motifs.

Exploratory target revision: intact endpoint point clouds of surviving ancestors,
ranked by mean terminal-descendant credit. Keep intact prototypes, excluding
near copies by fixed-frame Hungarian RMS <=0.001Angstrom. This threshold only
removes near duplicates; it does not certify distinct structural basins. A node
may have fewer teachers. Base prior gives equal batches then equal ancestors,
not a multiplicity bonus or more mass to batches with more teachers. Geometric
nearest-K restriction and offline scores subsequently alter that conditional
prior. This retains spatial detail but narrows early diversity; it need not improve
free generation or final affinity. Missing early credit contrasts are an explicit
limitation, not a fitted trend. Empirical survival functions are piecewise linear
summaries on observed support, not physical velocity or a direct force.

the same per-batch teacher cap2 (R7 actually28 teachers/node, not140),
endpoint_pointcloud, actual FLOWR endpoint VJP, eta .3, K4, beta2, teacher
temperature4A2, tau .5, curvature1A and time-ramp power0. Reward uses conditional
Hungarian correspondences, offline teacher priors and intact matched coordinates.

supported updates active, then continue native inference to1.

to current coordinates with fixed self-conditioning, anchor, assignments and
prior. A lagged post-native response is first-order only, not an extra measured
reward. A new reference requires one-time actual FLOWR finite differences and
full100-step zero/native equality; CPU evidence does not establish GPU validity.

ancestor-collapse counts, distinguish last recorded head from final rescore,
preserve null extinction labels, reject full-window sparse credit stratification,
and compile only the declared registered coordinate loss. Hash echoes alone are
not behavioral evidence. Keep literal output and concise evidence-to-formula
reasoning, not private reasoning transcripts. Independent review before activation.

---
name: evomolsteer-affinity-regional-pointcloud
description: Mine whole-window endpoint local moments and design coherent regional point-cloud guidance, checking numeric behavior before activation.
---

Final predicted target affinity is primary. Preserve the measured global winner
when a trial regresses. Strain is secondary after a clear gain. Report mean,
unique mean, best, Top5, failures and coverage separately; historical Steer100 is
a subset benchmark, not its verified full maximum or a paired heldout arm.

Read all supplied evidence before designing. Small signed average response alone
does not establish a small dose: actual finite differences, zero/native parity,
injection RMS, individual absolute changes and terminal persistence decide that.
For flat response consider strength; for worse affinity revise coordinate targets
or missing features; positive gains below Steer justify retaining and refining.
Treat R6 and R9 window-to-final loss as active-control counterevidence, and R10
as evidence a stronger dose need not beat R7. No unmeasured causal claims.

Use the entire dynamic learned selection window, with exact observed functions
at its nodes. No arbitrary time bins, polynomial extrapolation or hardcoded .5.
200 new fields describe Gaussian-region soft mass, three directed local means
and six covariance entries in the receptor frame. Parent-debias offspring before
equal-batch inference. BH covers all600 predeclared field/measure tests jointly.
Whole-window enrichment, enrichment change and actual parent-edge increment
contrast are distinct measures. Increment contrasts are forecast changes, not
physical atom velocities or a spatial force. Preserve source and prior bindings.

Overlapping Gaussian regions can all associate with a global shape change. All20
supported regions do not prove20 independently causal affinity motifs. Negative
covariance effects do not justify universal compression. The strongest reproducible
soft-mass region is an exploratory localization, selected from supplied summaries
by positive whole-window effect, q<.05 and >=12/14 positive batches, then greatest
effect. Whole-window positive enrichment can have negative first/last node effects:
report both numeric signs and never turn it into constant signed attraction.

The information audit compares two nearest-neighbor geometries. Its nonnegative
excess RMS is true by construction; it is not an affinity result. Report both
teacher-score correlations: compressed matching need not have lower correlation.
This audit motivates studying coordinate detail but cannot explain R7 causally.

The registered new family is endpoint_regional_pointcloud. Retain coherent elite
point clouds in receptor coordinates, separate prototypes, Hungarian correspondences
and offline recorded score priors. For current endpoint anchor A, landmark p_r,
regional weight w_r and radius l, freeze a_i=b+sum_r w_r exp(-|A_i-p_r|²/(2l²)).
For matched prototype T_k use q_k=sum_i a_i|Y_i-T_ki|²/sum_i a_i and robust cost
rho_k=delta²(sqrt(1+q_k/delta²)-1). R=tau logsumexp(log(pi_k)-rho_k/tau).
Assignments, priors and attention are detached: differentiate the conditional
coordinate loss only. Do not claim a total derivative of recomputed membership.
Positive b retains force outside the region; there is no atom/graph acceptance
gate, resampling, cloning or affinity-head loss. A finite upper reward is not a
finite lower bound. Only actual predicted coordinates use gradients through FLOWR.

First isolate regional emphasis from R7: eta=.3, K4, beta2, teacher temperature4A²,
radius5A, background.25, tau.5, delta1, constant region salience, time ramp power0.
Choose only the strongest reproducible positive soft-mass region by the recorded
rule above. Keep all supported updates active; continue native inference after
the learned window to1. Later registered counterfactuals may change region scope,
radius or empirical absolute-effect stage salience. An absolute effect is an
amplitude, not a signed spatial gradient. Retain the global parent on regression.

Use the already required model forward and actual endpoint VJP. No production
extra forward/head call or head gradient; fixed self-conditioning and endpoint
anchor. Preflight adds4 one-time actual FLOWR forwards and must pass. New family
also requires full100step zero/native equality. CPU/fixture tests do not certify
GPU behavior. Lagged post-native reward response is first-order only at old x_t.

Return the requested JSON, binding exact Skill/input/prompt/reference/region-prior
hashes, selecting the affinity-first parent, responding to all four numeric cases,
quoting numeric R9/R10 evidence and the whole-window/node-sign contradiction,
and explaining overlap, conditional gradients and correlation limitations.
Keep literal responses and concise evidence-to-formula decisions, not private
reasoning transcripts. Tests must detect decisions responding to these rules;
hash echoes alone are insufficient. Independent review precedes activation.

All edits and analysis are local, committed and VPN-pushed, then exact-commit
remote pull, verified cleanup and inference/export only. Protect original Steer
and checkpoints; keep compact reports and scores before deleting generated data.
Freeze the discovery winner before fresh validation; do not tune on heldout.
